audit_scope.description: This audit covers EL precompile validation (EIP-7823 MODEXP bounds), EL transaction validation (EIP-7825 gas limit cap), and CL/P2P data availability sampling (EIP-7594 PeerDAS). Both EL and CL are materially present.

out_of_scope: Fork Choice (not covered by these EIPs)
Attestation logic (not covered by these EIPs)

out_of_scope_reasons.JSON-RPC API: Explicitly out-of-scope per Ethereum Bug Bounty — vulnerabilities requiring publicly exposed API
out_of_scope_reasons.Beacon API: Explicitly out-of-scope per Ethereum Bug Bounty — vulnerabilities requiring publicly exposed API
out_of_scope_reasons.Infrastructure bugs: Webpages, DNS, email, etc. are out-of-scope
out_of_scope_reasons.Configuration errors: Requires node operator error, not external attack
out_of_scope_reasons.High-effort DoS: Sustained, CPU or bandwidth intensive, and/or requires more than 1 packet or on-chain transaction
out_of_scope_reasons.Non-Fusaka vulnerabilities: Should be submitted via the Ethereum Foundation's Bug Bounty Program

trusted_external_entities.name: P2P Peer Nodes (PeerDAS Column Custodians)
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: P2P Network — column sampling requests/responses, data_column_sidecar gossip
trusted_external_entities.rationale: P2P peers are unauthenticated. Any node can join the network and send arbitrary column data, invalid KZG proofs, or withhold columns. All received column data must be fully validated via KZG proof verification.

trusted_external_entities.name: Blob Transaction Submitter via P2P Gossip
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Transaction submitters are unauthenticated. Blob transactions received via gossip may contain invalid blobs, malformed cell proofs, or mismatched commitment counts. Full validation pipeline required (blob count, quantity match, cell proof count, KZG hash, batch cell proof verification).

trusted_external_entities.name: Transaction Submitter via RPC or P2P
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Transaction senders are untrusted. They may submit transactions with gasLimit exceeding the 16,777,216 cap (EIP-7825) or craft transactions that call MODEXP with oversized inputs (EIP-7823). All transaction parameters must be validated before mempool admission.

trusted_external_entities.name: Peer Node Broadcasting Blocks via P2P
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Peer nodes are unauthenticated. A malicious peer could broadcast blocks containing transactions with gasLimit exceeding the cap. Block validation must check every transaction's gasLimit against the 16,777,216 cap.

trusted_external_entities.name: Contract/EOA Calling MODEXP Precompile
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: On-chain transaction calling precompile at address 0x05
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Any on-chain entity can call the MODEXP precompile with arbitrary input. The precompile must enforce the 1024-byte upper bound on BASE, EXPONENT, and MODULUS lengths (EIP-7823) and consume all gas on violation.

trusted_external_entities.name: Consensus Layer via Engine API
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Authenticated via JWT. Co-located CL communicates execution payloads to EL. However, payload content (e.g., transactions in blocks) still requires full validation by EL including gas limit cap checks and precompile input bounds. A compromised CL could send payloads with invalid transactions.

trusted_external_entities.name: Malicious Validator via P2P
trusted_external_entities.entry_point: P2P Network — beacon block proposals, attestation gossip
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Validators are unauthenticated at the P2P layer. A malicious validator could propose blocks with unavailable blob data, attempt to manipulate column custody assignments, or selectively withhold columns to exploit PeerDAS reconstruction thresholds.

boundary_edges.security_assumption: All received columns must have KZG proofs batch-verified before being accepted. Insufficient or invalid samples must result in data unavailability determination, not silent acceptance.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: P2P column request for data reconstruction
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Columns received for reconstruction must be individually verified. Reconstruction requires at least 50% of columns. Malicious peers may provide invalid columns to corrupt reconstruction.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: P2P blob transaction gossip validation pipeline
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Full validation required: blob count <= 6, quantity match (hashes/blobs/commitments), cell proof count = CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB * len(blobs), KZG commitment-to-hash verification, batch cell proof verification. Failure at any step must reject the transaction.
Transaction gasLimit must be validated against the 16,777,216 (2^24) cap per EIP-7825. Transactions exceeding the cap must be rejected before mempool admission.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: Block validation — per-transaction gas limit check
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Every transaction in a received block must have its gasLimit checked against the 16,777,216 cap. Blocks containing any transaction exceeding the cap must be rejected as invalid.

length_of_BASE, length_of_EXPONENT, and length_of_MODULUS must each be checked against the 1024-byte upper bound per EIP-7823. Violation must consume all call gas and return error. Check must be identical across all client implementations to avoid consensus splits.

Although authenticated via JWT, execution payloads must still be fully validated by EL. Transactions within payloads must pass EIP-7825 gas limit cap checks. MODEXP calls within payload execution must enforce EIP-7823 bounds. Blob data from engine_getBlobsV2 should be verified.

boundary_edges.target_component_interface: P2P beacon block proposal / blob sidecar gossip
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Block proposals must have blob data availability verified via PeerDAS sampling before acceptance. Validators proposing blocks with unavailable data must not cause the node to finalize unavailable blocks.
